title: nephrodium pusillum

The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that may help to reduce stress, improve respiratory health, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Nephrodium pusillum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
